| `--case <id>` | every enabled case | Run only this exact c
ase id. Repeatable. |\n| `--server <name=url>` | | Bind a target server to an HTTP(S) URL. Repeatable. Split on the first `=`; dup
licate or unknown names are usage errors. |\n| `--mcp-config <path>` | | Explicit MCP JSON config, consulted before `./.mcp.json`
and `./.mcpjam/mcp.json`. A missing or invalid file fails setup. |\n| `--host <template>` | none | Emulate one host template's han

dshake and settings. Never launches the real client. |
| `--inference <mode>` | `auto` | `auto`, `byok` or `mcpjam`. |
--

Glo
bal `--timeout` bounds each setup operation and MCP request, not the whole run. Exit codes: `0` passed, `1` failed, `2` usage/unsu
pported/import/policy, `3` credentials, `4` setup/billing/artifact, `5` inconclusive or interrupted — see [Exit codes](https://doc

s.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md#exit-codes).

ch is refused with a `409` and nothing is created. Omit to accept whatever split applies. |
